title: Built tile
description: An industry tile placed in a city slot. (city, slot-index) is unique across the board.

city.description: Board-location id of the build location. Includes the two farm breweries.

slot-index.description: Index into that location's slots array. Part of the move id, so the slot order is frozen data.

level.description: Tile level, taken from the head of the owner's mat stack. Every level-1 tile is purged from the board at the canal-to-rail transition.

flipped.description: Flipped tiles score their vp and have already paid their income spaces. Resource tiles flip when drained; sellable tiles flip when sold.

resources.description: Cubes for coal/iron (from tile-spec.produces), barrels for a brewery (from beerProduced(era): 1 canal, 2 rail), always 0 for cotton/manufacturer/pottery.
